cannula._comment: ALL TODO-MEASURE (no public data; guessed from photos). Insight Flex cannula head = round transparent dome with a side septum; the tubing-side connector slides on sideways. See cannula-measurement.md. Measurement letters A..P.

seal._comment: Cast silicone bead seal, three mould variants (op_seal.py, op_mould.py, SEAL-AND-DEAD-VOLUME.md). free_oversize = cavity tip diameter minus 16.0 (before cast shrink ~0.1-0.2 %).

S1.role: fall-back: more squeeze (~0.047 mm per side), single front bead, land 0.20; use if S2 leaks

S2.role: ACTIVE (CAD) / lowest friction: land 0.15, net squeeze ~0.03 mm per side; leak margin thinner

T.role: twin bead (redundant seal, longer guide), about 1.7x the friction of S1 (use if S1 leaks)

guide._note: [ASM] mu_g = core flange vs PP bore, silicone-oil wetted. tape_recess: both core flanges are turned down by this much per side so that one wrap of 0.1 mm PTFE thread-seal tape (optional) restores the 0.1 mm clearance and lowers the guide friction to ~0.10 (see SEAL-AND-DEAD-VOLUME.md, cocking).

_notes: Rev A orderable. See parts.md / README.md.

bench._comment: Bench pod (spec 4a). u = x - x_r1. All board features are relative to x_r1 -> one board for all sizes.
bench.revB_motor_contacts_note: Rev B spring-contact variant: order the NFP motor WITHOUT lead; pins B,A-,B+,A at 1.2 mm pitch, see layout.json motor_pins_revB

gears._comment: GHW-Modellbau module 0.3 brass gears (gear-selection.md), modelled as TIP circles. DECISION 2026-11-19 (coordinator + sim): STEP-DOWN pair z16 (motor, GHW 390754, bore 2.0) : z20 (screw, GHW 753020 20 Z B, bore 2.0, hub trimmed). Screw turns z_motor/z_screw = 0.8 per motor turn: U/step = 0.00494 x 16/20 = 0.003951 (firmware preset needs ratio 26.45 x 20/16 = 33.06). Theoretical centre 0.15 x 36 = 5.40, built centre = theoretical + centre_add 0.11 = 5.51 (backlash window, sim 3.1). 15:12 (4.05) and 15:15 (4.50) cannot clear the carriage lane (needs >= 5.5 with the 4.8 mm carriage); 20:16 / 18:18 tips do not fit the 6.7 mm cavity without relief. z20 tip OD 6.6: 0.25 mm floor and lid relief pockets over the screw gear. x0 = gear plane start (rear corner limits the motor-gear tip circle to x >= 2.5, dry screw bosses at x 0.9..3.1 limit it to the screw-gear tip).

shim._comment: stainless steel tongue shim (laser cut, 0.5 x 1.4) glued into a carriage pocket; replaces the printed tongue (sim 4.4-4.6)

thrust._comment: axial stack of the leadscrew (bench side_gears): rear thrust sleeve (gear carrier, bears on the dry bush front face), front thrust collar (bears on the far bush end face), magnet glued to the rod end behind the collar: neither delivery nor draw thrust passes through the magnet. Sleeve/collar: brass tube or printed.

dock_interface_frozen._comment: FROZEN INTERFACE between the pod (bottom shell + end cap + pod sensor board) and the swappable DOCK INSERT (spec 8a). All insert variants fit this; the pod never changes for a new cannula fit. Pod frame: x relative to x_r1 (u), y relative to the dock axis y_c. Changing any number needs a decision entry in docs/STATUS.md.
dock_interface_frozen.needle_tip_x_u: dock.hub_x0 + dock.hub_t + dock.needle_free  (pod end cap, never changes)
dock_interface_frozen.mount: slide-in T-slot: the insert slides in along -X through the end-wall mouth until its front face meets the pod rear dock face at x0_u; the flange (z 0.5..0.88, |dy| up to pocket_half) runs on the ledge (z 0..0.45) so it cannot drop out towards the skin or move sideways; the d0.5 ledge bumps click into d0.9 holes in the flange (detent against the pull-off force); optional: a drop of cyanoacrylate. Tool-free swap: push the insert out with a pin from the open end.

dock._comment: pod side of the slide-on dock. y_c = dock axis in pod Y. arm_in = relaxed inner half spacing of the snap arms.

oring._note: catalogue O-ring 2.0 x 0.5 (NBR/silicone) in a face groove of the cap, sealing against the flat PP end face of the reservoir around the port: stretched 10 % on d2.2, cross-section 0.477, axial squeeze (0.477-0.40)/0.477 = 16 %. The d1.98 spigot only locates (clearance fit, NOT a seal).

cap._note_2026_11_19_review: septum bore = disc d x (1 - septum_compress) = 3.4 (radial compression 15 %), cavity 1.8 deep for a 2.0 disc (0.2 protrudes: the shell wall compresses it 0.1 axially, no air pocket behind it); needle hub bore = hub_d - hub_press (0.04 interference per side); main path channels d0.6 (L/D <= 5.3, flushable from both ends), fill branch d0.8 (drill/print straight legs).

sandwich._comment: clamped two-part sandwich (op_cap.py), spec 3c minimal fluid module. septum: disc (septum.d / len) or a bought septum (change d / len); needle: hub seat with UV-glued needle (dock.hub_d, cap.hub_press) or bare needle.

cap._note_3c: 2026-11-19 spec 3c: NO check valve, pressure fill. Minimal module: reservoir port -> septum chamber -> outlet needle. Septum on the UNDERSIDE (axis Z) at (x_r1 + septum_x, y_c - septum_dy), fill needle through cap.fill_hole_d and a hole in the pod floor; one gasket slot, no branches.

cover._comment: Hazard H14 (spec 3e): no check valve, so the fill septum must be physically unreachable while docked. Omnipod-style: the septum is on the pod UNDERSIDE inside the Velcro patch footprint (the floor recess `velcro`, extended forward to x_r1 + x_end_u), so the patch covers the underside, and therefore the fill-needle hole, whenever the pod sits on it (docked); the pod must be removed and turned over to fill. check.py: the hole footprint (septum x, y, hole d + needle radius) must lie inside the patch footprint; a plate directly under the floor blocks every ray (any angle) through the hole.

coax._comment: Coaxial NFP motor + sleeve coupler (see op_coax.py). All lengths VERIFY with the real motor. valve_d/valve_len/dock.valve_x0 are LEGACY (coaxial layout only): the bench pod has no check valve since spec 3c.

reservoir_frozen._comment: CUP variant only (op_cup.prepare): un-frozen wide tank; bench keeps 16 x 5

reservoir_frozen.datums: A = open dry-end face (x = 0); B = bottom flat (z = 0 at the lower outer flat); C = bore centre plane (y = 0)

projection.note: coaxial leadscrew + wider bore (coordinator 2026-11-19): x_r1' = rear_stack + (res_len - stroke) + stroke', stroke' = stroke x 9.8 / 13.4; length' = x_r1' + dock tail (frozen tail_u)

cup._comment: v0.1.0 'cup' pod (--drive cup, op_cup.py, V010-CUP.md): ONE M1.6 x 0.35 rod on the tank axis, rotating + axially fixed (bush behind the gear pair), driven by the NFP-608-26.45 through exactly TWO gears (z16 -> z20). The plunger is a long cup (stadium 15.8 x 4.8, seals at the closed front end, blind bore d2.0, brass nut in a hex pocket at the rear): the rod screws INTO it from behind and never touches the liquid. Tank = frozen CNC bore without slot. Dock tunnel BESIDE the tank, running the whole pod length, mouth in the rear (dry) end wall; end cap / needle at the front end. Battery, USB-C, boards = reserved keep-out boxes (ko_*). Coordinates: x = 0 at the OUTLET (front) end, +X toward the dry end; y = 0 at the -Y wall; z = 0 skin side.

magnet.note: diametric N52 disc on the rod end; its front face is the reverse-thrust stop on the bush rear face (friction loads only, VERIFY: fallback = 1.0 mm collar, +1.05 mm pod length)

battery.part: Ampul 301030 Li-Pol 3.7 V, 3.0 x 10 x 30 mm, 90 mAh listed (60 mAh realistic per the Liter table), integrated protection chip, two wires, EUR 4.00, https://ampul.eu/en/battery/6782-li-pol-battery-90mah-37v-301030 (page read; measure on arrival); backup: Soldered 350824 40 mAh JST-PH (BerryBase.de), mechanical/battery-selection.md.
